# MEDJAY

> MEDJAY is a sales psychology training brand founded by Steven Saad. It teaches real estate agents, sales teams and founders how to sell by understanding how buyers decide — through free self-study courses, books, and trainer-led programs for companies.

## Start here

- [MEDJAY — Sales Psychology Training](https://medjay.pro/): Homepage — what MEDJAY is and how to start.
- [Programs](https://medjay.pro/programs/): All MEDJAY programs — self-study, enterprise and video courses.

## Articles

- [Your First Day at Work: What to Do (and What Not to Do)](https://medjay.pro/articles/first-day-at-work-what-to-do): How to behave on your first day at a new job.
- [Your First Week at Work: How to Settle In and Earn Trust](https://medjay.pro/articles/first-week-at-work-how-to-settle-in): How to settle in and earn trust in your first week at a new job.
- [Your First Month at Work: How to Prove Yourself Without Burning Out](https://medjay.pro/articles/first-month-at-work-how-to-prove-yourself): How to prove yourself in your first month at a new job.
- [What Happens After You Get Your Real Estate License?](https://medjay.pro/articles/what-happens-after-you-get-your-real-estate-license): What a new real estate agent does after getting licensed in the USA.
- [How to Become a Real Estate Agent in Dubai](https://medjay.pro/articles/how-to-become-a-real-estate-agent-in-dubai): The licence route in Dubai — join a brokerage, take the accredited course, pass the RERA exam, get your broker card.

## Free courses

- [Retail Sales Essentials](https://medjay.pro/courses/retail-sales-essentials/): Free 5-day course — from floor seller to top performer in retail sales.
- [Counter Sales Essentials](https://medjay.pro/courses/counter-sales-essentials/): Free 5-day course — selling over the counter.
- [Tele Sales Essentials](https://medjay.pro/courses/tele-sales-essentials/): Free 5-day course — selling by phone.
- [B2B Sales Essentials](https://medjay.pro/courses/b2b-sales-essentials/): Free 5-day course — business-to-business selling.
- [Customer Service Essentials](https://medjay.pro/courses/customer-service-essentials/): Free 5-day course — what the job is, first contact, angry customers and closing.
- [Call Center Essentials](https://medjay.pro/courses/call-center-essentials/): Free 5-day course — how a call center works, the call from start to finish, and upset callers.
- [Team Leader Essentials](https://medjay.pro/courses/team-leader-essentials/): Free 5-day course — leading a sales team.
- [Assistant Manager Essentials](https://medjay.pro/courses/assistant-manager-essentials/): Free 5-day course — the assistant manager role in sales.
- [Store Manager Essentials](https://medjay.pro/courses/store-manager-essentials/): Free 5-day course — running a store and its numbers.
- [Area Manager Essentials](https://medjay.pro/courses/area-manager-essentials/): Free 5-day course — managing several stores or branches.
- [Sales Manager Essentials](https://medjay.pro/courses/sales-manager-essentials/): Free 5-day course — setting targets, reading KPIs and coaching a sales team.
- [First Customer](https://medjay.pro/founders/first-customer/): Free 10-day course for founders — finding and closing your first paying customers.

## Programs

- [USA Real Estate — Video Course](https://medjay.pro/programs/usa-real-estate-video/): 72 video lessons, about 18 hours, for real estate agents in the USA.
- [UAE Real Estate — Video Course](https://medjay.pro/programs/uae-real-estate-video/): 101 video lessons, about 24 hours, for new real estate brokers in the UAE.
- [RAK Real Estate Enterprise](https://medjay.pro/programs/rak-real-estate-enterprise/): Trainer-led sales program for real estate brokerages in Ras Al Khaimah.
- [Selling to Contractors](https://medjay.pro/programs/selling-to-contractors/): Trainer-led sales program for industrial distribution and rental teams selling to contractors.
